gates.peak_memory: max(native three worker OS peak RSS bytes) <= max(python three worker OS peak RSS bytes); zero tolerance
gates.noise_result: inconclusive; never widen gates or selectively rerun
gates.timing_aggregate: median of all 15 samples per backend
gates.p95: linear percentile; descriptive only, not a production SLO
gates.numerical_contract: native_emd_contract.json; no waiver for budget or metadata differences

measurement_boundary.time: complete public EMD family call including Python outer loops/RNG/aggregation and necessary input conversion/output ownership; exclude imports/vector I/O/warmup/summary/profile
measurement_boundary.peak_rss: OS high water from fresh worker start through last measured call, read before metric serialization; include actual imports, input, warmup and output lifetimes
measurement_boundary.correctness: separate workers before any timing; same backend repeat arrays exact; cross backend frozen array and metadata budget
measurement_boundary.profile: separate worker; excluded from time and memory gates
measurement_boundary.allocation_reporting: observed ndarray input/output/copy bytes and source-derived linear scratch bound are distinct from OS RSS; no claim of instrumented total native allocations
measurement_boundary.reruns: all three scheduled blocks run; resume only never-started workers; completed or interrupted worker cannot be overwritten
